SELECT R.REPORT_ID, R.USER_ID, R.REPORT_NAME, R.GENERATE_TYPE, TO_CHAR(R.PERIOD_FROM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PERIOD_FROM, TO_CHAR(R.PERIOD_TO, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PERIOD_TO, R.DATA_TYPES, R.FILE_NAME, R.FILE_PATH, R.FILE_SIZE, TO_CHAR(R.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT FROM TB_REPORT R
AND UPPER('RPT-' || CASE WHEN R.REPORT_ID < 100 THEN LPAD(CAST(R.REPORT_ID AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') ELSE CAST(R.REPORT_ID AS VARCHAR) END) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchReportNo}) || '%' ESCAPE '\'
AND R.REPORT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\'
AND R.GENERATE_TYPE = #{searchGenerateType}
AND (',' || R.DATA_TYPES || ',') LIKE '%,' || #{searchDataType} || ',%'
AND R.REG_DT >= CAST(#{searchDateFrom} AS TIMESTAMP)
AND R.REG_DT < CAST(#{searchDateTo} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 day'
ORDER BY R.REG_DT DESC, R.REPORT_ID DESC

SELECT R.REPORT_ID, R.USER_ID, R.REPORT_NAME, R.GENERATE_TYPE, TO_CHAR(R.PERIOD_FROM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PERIOD_FROM, TO_CHAR(R.PERIOD_TO, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PERIOD_TO, R.DATA_TYPES, R.FILE_NAME, R.FILE_PATH, R.FILE_SIZE, TO_CHAR(R.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT FROM TB_REPORT R WHERE R.REPORT_ID = #{reportId}
SELECT R.REPORT_ID, R.FILE_NAME, R.FILE_PATH FROM TB_REPORT R WHERE R.REPORT_ID = #{reportId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REPORT R WHERE R.GENERATE_TYPE = 'AUTO' AND R.DATA_TYPES = #{dataTypes} AND R.PERIOD_FROM = CAST(#{periodFrom} AS DATE) AND R.PERIOD_TO = CAST(#{periodTo} AS DATE)
